facts.fact: 塔拉辛回想当年与噬世者交战那夜，她曾故意装作不想要这种温柔。
facts.anchor: She’d made a show of not wanting it when he tried to take her like this the night they fought the World-Eater.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛把母亲被乌尔杜佳害死的话埋进阿拉里克的头发里说出来。
阿拉里克低声说他自己也是她的家人。
facts.anchor: “I’m your family, too,” Alaric said quietly

facts.fact: 阿拉里克在斜照到胸口的晨光里醒来，满心餍足。
facts.anchor: He woke to the sun’s rays slanted across his torso and a feeling of deep contentment.

facts.fact: 凯德压低声音说凯萨斯最高指挥部知道虚空坠焰源头在哪、是什么。
facts.anchor: “Kesathese High Command will know where the Voidfell source is. What it is,” Khaede said in a low voice

facts.fact: 塔拉辛对阿拉里克说她想列席一两次议事会。
facts.anchor: “I was actually thinking that I might like to attend a council session or two.”

facts.fact: 日落时分，内纳瓦伦的传信鹰落到夜后的阳台上。
facts.anchor: A messenger eagle from the Nenavar Dominion arrived at sunset.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛迟疑地判定梦里那处洞穴长屋是黎明群岛。
facts.anchor: “I think that was the Dawn Isles,” Talasyn hesitantly concluded.
